exposure.needed: whether any Telemetry API CEL expressions use the old attributes (filter_state["wasm.downstream_peer"], filter_state["wasm.upstream_peer"], node, or unqualified wasm attributes such as istio_responseClass)

original.statement: Telemetry API CEL expressions must be updated to use standard Envoy attributes (filter_state.downstream_peer/upstream_peer, xds.node, fully qualified wasm.* attributes) instead of the custom Wasm extended attributes.

decision.reason: [ev-7e3267b542c5] and [ev-a3db376e8800] say that CEL expressions in the telemetry API must switch from the custom Wasm attributes to the standard Envoy attributes. The old forms are filter_state["wasm.downstream_peer"]/["wasm.upstream_peer"], node, and unqualified Wasm attributes such as istio_responseClass. So an environment is exposed only if its Telemetry CEL expressions use those old forms. Neither excerpt names the Telemetry resource field paths that hold CEL expressions, so a scoped resource/field predicate cannot be built from the evidence. An undecidable leaf whose "needed" lists exactly the old attributes is the right shape; the reason code could also be read as an evidence gap.
